status: retrospective model comparison, not blind validation
selection: Compare the existing Gaussian reconstruction with the constant-eddy-viscosity similarity solution and a separately measured Gaussian coefficient. No optimization against Hussein targets is permitted. Keep all candidates and the original threshold in the report.

candidates.name: gaussian_ricou
candidates.source: Ricou-Spalding 1961 direct entrainment coefficient; existing baseline

candidates.name: gaussian_huck
candidates.source: Huck et al. 2022, Table 3 and equation 3.5, DOI 10.1017/jfm.2021.992
candidates.derivation: For this mean-flow Gaussian integral model, C=1/(2 alpha^2), hence alpha=1/sqrt(2 C). Only C is transferred; do not also impose independently incompatible decay/width constants.
candidates.limitations: Gas proxy conditioned on roughly 1 micrometre droplets in an air-water spray, not an independent single-phase gas measurement. No reported uncertainty for this rounded C. Transferring it to the single-phase holdout is an explicit model assumption. It is not a nozzle prescription for the Montazeri case.

candidates.name: squared_lorentzian_ricou
candidates.source: Constant-eddy-viscosity boundary-layer similarity solution; Ricou-Spalding entrainment sets dimensional growth
candidates.provenance: Basset et al. 2022 equations 3.4 and 5.10; f=(1+A eta^2)^(-2), with constant radial turbulent viscosity. No measured width imposed.

holdout: Unchanged Hussein et al. LDA profile and integral summaries in reference.json
